dsh-desktop-pet 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0909086fd483abf9c965.html
posts.en:
dsh-desktop-pet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0909086fd483abf9c965.html
